instructions: Rework the blocked open-source-package-readiness-final-pass run. The previous run was blocked because the exact npm pack command hit user npm cache ownership outside worker authority; this task keeps the same implementation scope but uses a task-owned /tmp npm cache in verification. Read package.json, README.md, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, references/initiatives/open-source-readiness.md, references/operations/open-source-public-release-checklist.md, references/operations/open-source-governance-package-readiness.md, references/operations/open-source-artifact-map.md, references/operations/open-source-first-run-demo-dogfood.md, and the blocked run log if available. Complete safe combined scope for remaining plan items 2-4: package metadata hygiene, package contents/dogfood-private verification, and final release readiness report. Update package.json only for public-facing metadata and package contents hygiene: replace the personal description, add license MIT, repository, bugs, homepage, keywords, engines for Bun, and a conservative files array. Keep private: true. Do not add bin, publishConfig, package runner claims, npm/bunx/npx claims, scripts, dependencies, or version changes. Do not modify bun.lock or bun.lockb. Update the initiative and readiness docs so S6 is completed, governance files commit 17d6349 is recorded, package metadata/package contents are clone-only ready, and package publication remains deferred. Create references/operations/open-source-package-readiness-final-pass.md with package metadata changes, package dry-run evidence, excluded dogfood/private surfaces, remaining blockers, and next action. Preserve that references/thread-control/** is excluded from public onboarding and package contents by default. Do not edit README.md, source, tests, examples, GitHub templates, top-level governance files, run logs, worktrees, generated state, task specs, task templates, agent profiles, playbooks, lessons, or artifact locations. Do not remove private: true. Do not publish a package. Do not change GitHub repository visibility. Do not run demo:first-run from inside the worker because workers must not spawn nested workers; cite accepted demo evidence instead. If honest completion requires package publishing, private: true removal, bin/publishConfig implementation, README rewrite, source changes, artifact movement/deletion, or GitHub repo visibility changes, stop and report the blocker instead of editing those surfaces. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
